description: Source code for cellular manager plugin main APIs, including object creation, removal, and initialization functions, with system event handling and external dependencies.

methods.name: BackEndManagerCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new backend manager object, allocating memory and setting function pointers.

methods.name: BackEndManagerRemove
methods.description: Removes the backend manager object, frees resources, and closes system event handle.

methods.name: BackEndManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend manager, sets up system configuration, opens system event, and creates cellular handle.
